meta.name: abp-development-flow
meta.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4/10.5) development flow: adding a new entity end-to-end (Domain → Domain.Shared → repository → EF Core config → migration → Contracts/DTO → object mapping → app service → localization → permission → test). Use when you need the flow for adding a new feature in ABP.

howto.what: 指导你按 ABP Framework v10.x 的分层模板，一步步添加新实体：从定义实体、DTO、服务到数据库迁移、本地化、权限和测试。
howto.when: 当你要在 ABP 项目中添加新实体或新功能时（例如说“ABP add new entity”、“ABP 添加功能”等关键词）。

howto.what_en: Guides you through the ABP Framework v10.x layered template to add a new entity end-to-end: from defining the entity, DTO, service to migration, localization, permissions, and tests.
howto.when_en: When you need to add a new entity or feature in an ABP project, e.g., saying "ABP add new entity" or "ABP add feature".

say_en.text: Help me add a Book entity in my ABP project.
